description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Samarasinha Arachchilage Janaka Priyantha Samarasingha as a member of North Central Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Polonnaruwa and Mr. Hewa Waduge Roy Kalinda as a member the Uva Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Moneragala
